verdict.rationale: An LLM gateway could plausibly offer a documented no-training policy or provider training opt-out controls, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no such capability. The closest item (litellm-docs-12) only stops messages and responses from reaching the user's logging provider, which is an adjacent logging control and not a training opt-out.
